titleStmt.title: Form Suggested for the Affidavit to be Signed and Sworn to by the Soldier Contemplating Marriage

head.hi: Form Suggested for the Affidavit to be Signed and Sworn to by the Soldier Contemplating Marriage

div.p: I, _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Rank) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (Name) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (No.) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Organization) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (N.A., N.G., or R.A.) of United States, make oath and say that I was born at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (Town) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (State) on _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _; (Date) that my present home address is _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (No.) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (Street) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, (Town) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _;(State) that I am unmarried; and that I know of no reason why I have not capacity to contract a valid marriage; that I have _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ been married before.
My former wife _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Died or was divorced) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Date)

Signed by the said _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _(Name) in my presence and by him sworn to before me this _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ day of _ _ _ _ _ _._ _ _ _ _ 191_ _ _ at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _.

note.p: Note: If deceased or divorced, a certified copy of death certificate or of decree of divorce furnished by civil authorities must he attached to this paper.
